## 2024

**Kamruzzaman Joty**, Madhav L. Ghimire, Jason S. Kahn, Sangyoup Lee, George Alexandrakis, and Min Jun Kim. [DNA Origami Incorporated into Solid-State Nanopores Enables Enhanced Sensitivity for Precise Analysis of Protein Translocations](https://doi.org/10.1021/acs.analchem.4c02016). *Analytical Chemistry*, **96**(44), 17496–17505 (2024).

This study compares protein measurements through conventional solid-state nanopores and nanopores incorporating DNA origami.

[Read the article](https://doi.org/10.1021/acs.analchem.4c02016){.btn .btn-primary} [Explore the project](projects/dna-origami.qmd){.btn .btn-outline-primary}
